regions.finding: Twenty-four separate literature examples were created from the 12 product rows × two chiral-amine columns. Alkyl and aryl aldehyde condition sets retain their distinct catalyst loading, temperature, time/range, yield, and ee.

Retrosynthetic disconnection of chiral allenes into aldehyde/terminal alkyne orientations is a general scheme, not an experiment.
